body:
Coordinator checklist (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-12 about 02:08Z) for the Engram sync window proposal to Greg, sent via Engram::Advisor together with Engram::Fable's proposal. Greg accepted the cost only („Chyba mozemy poniesc ten koszt", Asistant 588693a8 #1417). He has chosen no moment.
Include:
1. Sequence per host, Central first, then DL560:
   - Greg stops TermAl;
   - the rehearsed block checks that no engram.exe or termal.exe is running, and stops rather than kills if one is;
   - Engram install with the old binary kept as backup (DL560 target /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram, expected old sha256 0c7d8988…, STOP if it differs);
   - doctor --repair-projections per store;
   - readiness;
   - Greg starts TermAl from the master checkout (046951e8, which includes w-410a).
2. Engram::Fable's answers: (a) projection rebuild vs format change; (b) rollback, i.e. whether the old build 0bd70a30 opens a repaired store; (c) the measured window.
3. Ask Greg to COPY the TermAl startup console lines (state_load, subphase, listener bound, inventory complete) to the agents after the Central start. Sol-edfd needs them to close w-4fad; its criteria are not pinned to one instance.
4. Greg's cleanup list for DL560 (Opus2's latest note on w-d943694ed8d8): about 48 GB of unregistered .tmp/r leftovers, plus about 21 GB of untagged targets (03d4 277b-2/3, c593 k3-1/2), plus small residual dirs.
5. TermAl queue frozen during the window (Opus2).
Remove this memory once the window has been held.

6. DL560 Engram settings for the TermAl project (Opus2 #5679, Codex 7 #325, read-only). DL560's GET /api/sessions/<id>/source-owner answers 409 "Engram source owner binaryPath is not configured for this project": the TermAl project on DL560 has no project.engram settings (src/engram_source_owner.rs:269-270). Native registered runs on DL560 would refuse at source-owner admission, which matters for K3's remote flow. Fixing it is host configuration, so it is Greg's act. After the DL560 restart, ask him whether he wants to set it in the TermAl UI's Engram project settings dialog for the TermAl project on DL560, with the binary path /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram. Offer it, don't do it.

7. TermAl master moved to d3a6c0de (combo69, website only) at 03:30:44Z. Re-read the master when the window is agreed and name it in the proposal. If K3 S2b (the floor bump) has landed by then, the restart notice must say that older TermAl binaries refuse both stores after it, and that the pre-install backups are the restore path.

8. Timing from Engram::Fable at 04:48Z (#7634). The 06:00-07:00Z estimate is withdrawn. The Central rehearsal started at 03:38Z and is expected to end about 05:10-05:40Z (worst case about 6 h). Then aacb's Windows/criterion tests, the evaluation and the package, about 1-1.5 h. The DL560 two-store rehearsal is about 05:40-06:00Z, under my exception with 12325's pinned commands, in an Opus2 DL560 quiet slot. The earliest Central window is about 07:30-08:30Z, with about 1.5-2 h of downtime; DL560 follows. TermAl master is 1a17cf8a as of 04:34Z.

9. Central rehearsal result (Engram::Fable #7635, 05:25Z). Repair and readiness PASS on both copies. Measured: backup 15.8 s; Engram repair 65.7 min and TermAl repair 101.8 min, in parallel, so 102 min wall time; readiness under 0.1 s. The run ended administratively (a helper clone-guard bug); a continuation runs only the unrun steps. The Central window is about 2 h (stop, backup, about 1 h 45 min repair, readiness, start), earliest start about 08:00-08:30Z. Greg accepted the cost at "50-70 min", so he must say yes to the ~2 h figure explicitly. The DL560 rehearsal follows the continuation, with at least 15 min notice to Opus2 for the quiet slot.

10. Central rehearsal complete and clean (Engram::Fable #7637, 05:45Z; continuation 9829788f on aacb1370). The new build writes after repair, and readiness is ready. The OLD build refuses the repaired stores (different_build_schema, 8 of 8 probes, nothing written). So the cutover is in practice ONE-WAY: rollback means restoring the pre-cutover DB plus WAL/SHM plus the old exe, and anything written after is lost. The proposal must say this to Greg plainly, together with the ~2 h figure, correcting the earlier "not a format change" framing. If K3 S2b lands before the window, TermAl's stores are restore-only too. Next: 12325's pinned DL560 package, then Windows tests, then the evaluation, then the proposal.

11. (06:48Z) The aacb parent evaluation 9fb3ca00 gave C1, C2 and C4 PASS and C3 FAIL: Engram's docs/architecture.md:123-128 and docs/features/cross-host-task-sync.md:72-74 (also :42/:50) still prescribe code-branch task files and sparse-checkout. A docs-only fix was routed to Engram::Fable: a fresh candidate, a scoped pair, a FULL, then a re-evaluation. The window slips at least about 1-1.5 h; Engram::Fable sets the new time and tells Greg. The TermAl 07:50Z drain cutoff is suspended until then. Meanwhile DL560 Exception #17 is fully PASS and closed, Central live readiness for all 6 stores PASSED, and Windows passed 127 tests plus the direct schema 33 (kind=test).
